I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. It returns `{count, newest_title}` for the current user, and `newest_title` is `null` when they have no items. Superusers get the count and newest title across all items. I didn't run the tests or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been exercised.

- **Query:** `get_items_stats(*, session, owner_id)` in `backend/app/crud.py` does the database work, because `backend/app/CLAUDE.md` says route handlers must not touch the session. Passing `owner_id=None` means all items. The newest item is chosen by `created_at` descending, then `id` descending, so ties are deterministic.
- **Response model:** `ItemsStats` in `backend/app/models.py`.
- **Route:** `read_items_stats` in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`. It sits above `/{id}` so "stats" isn't parsed as an item id. The handler passes `None` as the owner for superusers and the user's id otherwise.

I haven't regenerated the frontend client. `docs/api.md` says to run `bash scripts/generate-client.sh` after endpoint changes and commit the result. I held off because it needs the backend's OpenAPI schema, which may mean starting the app. I also haven't added tests; `docs/testing.md` covers where they go.
